content:
ops_incident_bot: :pager: SEV2 alert — billing.metrics.token_drift detected. 15% higher token counts for prod-cust cohort since 12:03 UTC. Alert rule: token_delta > 10% for 10m.

ops_incident_bot: Pager routed to #incidents and on-call. Incident ID: INC-2026-1176.

sara_oncall: I'm on it, pulling the dashboards.
sara_oncall: seeing a sharp divergence in token_sharded_count vs emitter_raw_count around 12:02 UTC.
devin_sre: checking consumer lag now. running `kafka-consumer-lag --topic metering.events --group billing-agg`
devin_sre: lag ~0, partitions balanced. not a lag spike.
rami_engineer: I can tail the emitter logs, suspect duplicate events from emitter v2 rolling restart. tailing /var/log/emitter/v2/*
rami_engineer: found repeated ack for same event_id in logs at 12:02:10 - likely re-emitted on crash+retry.
elyse_billing: customers might have seen overage flags. Can we pause chargeable-flagging while we investigate?
sara_oncall: yes — initiating temporary suppress: `billing_bot pause-flagging --reason "token drift investigation" --until 13:30UTC` (we'll keep metering collection live).
billing_bot: Command accepted. Overage flagging paused (operator: sara_oncall).
product_ops: any customer-facing impact? need to draft comms if invoices might be affected.
rami_engineer: root cause looks like emitter restart combined with redis ack TTL set to 30s instead of 300s on v2 -> duplicates processed by aggregator when emitter got transient reconnect.
devin_sre: confirm: aggregator dedupe key uses redis TTL; when TTL small, ack expires and replays counted as new tokens.
devin_sre: pushing hotfix to increment TTL to 600s on billing-agg (config change). applying now.
sara_oncall: hotfix deployed to billing-agg config (ttl -> 600). rolling restart small window.
devin_sre: monitor metrics — token_delta back to baseline within 2 minutes.
rami_engineer: starting reconciliation job to dedupe duplicates from 12:00-12:10. Job: `backfill/dedupe window=12:00-12:10 --source=emitter-v2`
rami_engineer: estimated reprocessing time ~8m. will produce corrected counts to shadow ledger.
elyse_billing: good. once corrected, we'll re-run overage detection and re-enable flagging only after checks.
product_ops: can we also capture affected customer list for potential credits?
rami_engineer: yes — dedupe job outputs `affected_customer_ids.csv`. hooking into billing runbook.
sara_oncall: handoff: I'm taking first response now; devin, can you own overnight monitoring and finalize postmortem?
devin_sre: yep. I'll set alert sensitivity to ignore known transient duplicates for next 24h while we backfill and reconcile. Also will start a reconciler that compares shadow ledger to live ledger.
elyse_billing: flagging tentative customer impacts <0.2% of active customers; will prepare credit policy draft.
product_ops: prepping short customer note: "We detected transient double-counting for a subset of requests between 12:00–12:10 UTC due to emitter retries. No customer data was exposed. We will reconcile counts and apply credits where appropriate."
sara_oncall: re-enable flagging once reconciliation completes and shadow ledger matches within 0.1%. leaving comment in runbook.
ops_incident_bot: Incident INC-2026-1176 status: mitigation in place, suppressing overage flags, dedupe backfill running. Next update in 30m or on handoff.
devin_sre: assigning follow-up tasks: #1 root-cause PR to emitter retry logic (rami); #2 add integ test to simulate emitter restarts and verify dedupe TTL (devin/rami); #3 customer comms + credit plan (elyse).
rami_engineer: starting PR for emitter guard (limit re-emits on restart). ETA for PR: EOD.
devin_sre: FYI added temporary alert suppression rule: tag=known-duplication-until-1770003600.
elyse_billing: will wait for final reconciliation before issuing credits.
product_ops: thanks everyone. great quick coordination.
ops_incident_bot: Incident INC-2026-1176 closed to P1 (mitigated). Transitioning to post-incident review.
